sn35.79:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami …pe…
sn35.79:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca:
sn35.79:1.3: atthi nu kho bhante, eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:2.1: atthi kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:3.1: katamo pana bhante, eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti?
sn35.79:4.1: avijjā kho bhikkhu eko dhammo yassa pahāṇā bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
sn35.79:5.1: kathampana bhante, jānato kathampassato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti?
sn35.79:6.1: cakkhuṃ kho bhikkhu aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati. rūpe aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati. cakkhuviññāṇaṃ aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati. cakkhusamphassaṃ aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
sn35.79:6.2: yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati …pe… jivhaṃ aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati. rase …pe… jivhāviññāṇaṃ …pe… jivhāsamphassaṃ …pe… yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, tampi aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati …pe…
sn35.79:6.3: manaṃ aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati. dhamme …pe… manoviññāṇaṃ …pe… manosamphassaṃ …pe…
sn35.79:6.4: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi aniccato jānato passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati, vijjā uppajjati.
sn35.79:6.5: evaṃ kho bhikkhu jānato evaṃ passato bhikkhuno avijjā pahīyati vijjā uppajjatīti.
